title: The Lynx Who Loved Fine Print
story: Deep in the frozen amber mine, Obrynthal the Tally Lynx has caged 8 glow-kits — little lamp-foxes that light the miners' tunnels — and posted a ransom of 45 amber chits each. "Buy all eight," she purrs, "and I'll take 20% off the whole lot." Then her tail flicks to a tiny sign: a 10% cage fee is added to whatever you end up owing.
question: How many amber chits must Mr 6 pay to free all 8 glow-kits?
solution: Add the 10% cage fee: 288 × 1.1 = 316.8 amber chits.
praise: Reading the discount first was smart bargaining — the cage fee is charged on the new, smaller total, so there was one more percent step waiting at the end.
hint: Work the two percents in order: first shrink the 360 by 20%, then grow that answer by 10%.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 316.8 chits exactly, down to the last sliver — and Obrynthal, who had never met anyone who read the small sign, sheepishly unlocked every cage while the glow-kits lit the tunnel like a river of lanterns.
imagePrompt: A sly frost-furred lynx in a mine of glowing amber, tapping a tiny ransom sign with her tail while a small number-six knight calmly counts shining chits before eight caged lamp-foxes.
